name: Identificación de Modelo de Cámara
description: Identifica the source camera model through sensor patrón de ruidos and processing pipeline fingerprints.
algorithm: Sensor-Based Camera Source Identification via Processing Pipeline Analysis
mechanism: Each camera model has a unique processing pipeline including CFA interpolation, white balancing, color correction, and compresión JPEG. This method extracts características from these processing steps para identificar the source camera.
parameters: Features: color processing, CFA interpolation, JPEG tables, Classifier: SVM/RF, Training: per-model
source: Lukas, J. et al. (2006) — Digital Camera Identification from Sensor Pattern Noise, IEEE TIFS
useCase: Verificación de la cámara de origen declarada y detección de imágenes de fuentes desconocidas o IA

references.title: Lukas, J. et al. (2006) — Digital Camera Identification from Sensor Pattern Noise, IEEE TIFS

strengths:
• High precisión camera identification
• Based on physical sensor properties
• Difficult to spoof
• Works a través de camera brands
limitations:
• Requires reference images from known cameras
• Performance varies by camera model
• Social media compression reduces precisión
• Cannot identify specific camera instance
